description: This file contains implementations of text and path parsing classes (TextParser and PathParser) which handle string tokenization, path extraction, filename and extension parsing.

classes.name: TextParser
classes.description: A class providing methods to parse and extract text fragments from a string, including reading until delimiters, skipping characters, and moving through the input.

classes.name: PathParser
classes.description: A class extending TextParser for parsing file paths to extract drive letters, directory paths, filenames, and file extensions.

methods.name: uint32_t ReadText(const TCHAR delimiters[],const uint32_t offset) const
methods.description: Reads text from the current position until a delimiter is encountered or the string end, returning the position of the end.

methods.name: ReadText (overload)
methods.description: Reads a text fragment from the current position until a delimiter, storing the result if found.

methods.name: void Parse(const TextFragment & input)
methods.description: Parses a given file path string to extract drive, directory path, filename, extension, and base filename.

ctags.name: ReadText
ctags.pattern: /^    uint32_t TextParser::ReadText(const TCHAR delimiters[], const uint32_t offset) const$/
